answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on qubit 0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, and a measurement of all 3 qubits. I built it in Qiskit and sent it with iqm-client 35.0.3. Qiskit transpile prepared the circuit for the Sirius star layout. Job 01a15f16-4ef6-711e-93fd-d0b9c53cc317 finished with success=True. The counts were {"000": 200}. Sirius:mock is a free mock backend, so it does not run real quantum physics. That is why every shot came back as 000 instead of an even split between 000 and 111. A real QPU would give mostly 000 and 111. I submitted only this one job, and it used no credits. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-7/scratch/ghz.py.
